svg.aria-label: Ironproof cognitive operating system, with its organs plugged in
svg.text: THE WALL · ONLY LISTED DOORS OPEN TO THE OUTSIDE
the right memory on every request
every next action, kept or open
each wall noted with its way around
an error seen 3 times in 14 days
plans, picks the tools, runs them
no claim without command and output
our own hardware, not a cloud
hosts the knowledge graph and the code history
reads every organ: alive · dead · not exercised
